title: Drawing on the Powers of Heaven: Introduction and the Principles of Faith
summary: Discover how the powers of heaven—including inspiration, revelation, and priesthood power—can compensate for human weaknesses and magnify personal talents. Introducing Grant von Harrison's book, 'Drawing on the Powers of Heaven,' this message highlights that faith is a specific, actionable process governed by spiritual laws. By exercising agency and adhering to principles of righteousness, missionaries can draw down divine intervention that transcends distance and circumstance.
